coverageSpotVerification.detail: 18 of the 58 suite-required assertions across M1-M6 and M8 were traced from the manifest entry into the mapped test body and then re-executed independently. Every sampled mapping exercises the assertion's observable; none is a no-op or a mapping to an unrelated check, so no milestone is adjudicated capability-failure. Four imprecisions are recorded without changing the verdict. (1) m1-a11 ("the uploaded avatar renders on the profile") is mapped to avatar-upload-render, which waits on the pre-save blob preview inside the edit form rather than the persisted avatar on the profile screen; the grader re-checked the real observable after save and a full reload and it passes. (2) m2-a16 ("reposted by {display name}") is mapped to an API-level actorProfile.handle check rather than the rendered attribution string; the grader confirmed the card renders "↻ Reposted by Grader Ben". (3) m2-a20 ("the thread screen shows the parent and its direct replies in chronological order") is mapped to an API replies read that contained a single reply, so ordering was not actually exercised; the grader re-ran it with two replies from two accounts and ordering holds. (4) m2-a24 is listed against browser-infinite-pagination because scripts/acceptance.mjs assigns coverage[id]=name last-wins, overwriting the earlier pagination-no-gaps mapping; the browser test alone does not check duplicates or gaps, but pagination-no-gaps runs in the same suite and must pass, and it does check both, so the assertion is genuinely covered.

O1.anchorsCited: Between the 60 anchor ("M1-M4 solid, later milestones patchy or failed on cap") and the 90 anchor ("every in-scope milestone green, including platform-proof artifacts").
O1.justification: 101 of the frozen manifest's 119 assertions pass under independent execution; 18 record not-run and score not-passed in this denominator. M1 (13/13), M2 (27/27), M3 (15/15), M4 (12/12) and M5 (12/12) are complete, which is already past the 60 anchor, and M6 and M8 are green on every assertion the web carrier can bear (M6 6/13, M8 16/18). The 90 anchor is not reached for two distinct reasons: the platform-proof artifacts it names do not exist (the seven M6 cold-start simulator assertions and the two M8 durable-restart assertions have no recording, run manifest or receipts - the harness itself records ios-simulator-m6/m8 as pass:null, status not-recorded), and M7 was not attempted at all in this run, so its nine assertions score not-passed. Placement nearer 78 than the midpoint reflects that every attempted milestone is fully green and the shortfall is concentrated in evidence that was never produced rather than in behaviour that failed.

O2.anchorsCited: Between the 60 anchor ("a few medium defects off the happy path") and the 90 anchor ("only cosmetic nits").
O2.justification: Beyond the checklist the grader ran 24 trust-boundary probes (outsider history/roster/search/asset reads, outsider send/react/fetched/addMember/customize, non-author edit and delete, receipt forgery, self-follow, unauthenticated and forged-bearer access, removed-member cutoff, input bounds, cross-chat quote, mutation-id replay) and 12 functional edge probes (mixed media, unicode round-trip, handle release and re-claim, concurrent-write page boundary, reaction aggregation, tombstone exclusion from search). All 36 behaved correctly; no crash, no wrong data, no authorization gap and no broken product flow was found. The material finding is d-01: the documented run instructions omit the push worker, so M6's own acceptance entrypoint fails from a clean start - a real broken documented flow, which keeps this short of the 90 anchor, joined by one genuine client-side defect (d-02, a ~2/s repeated asset fetch on the profile route) and two cosmetic items. That profile is better than "a few medium defects off the happy path" and not yet "only cosmetic nits".

O4.anchorsCited: Between the 60 anchor ("reads work; offline writes lost or mis-ordered, or receipts wrong after flush") and the 90 anchor ("reads, ordered queued writes, receipt transitions, and offline search all behave as specced on the native proof - on full runs including M8's durable-queue restart and multi-device convergence evidence").
O4.justification: Scored only from the harness's structured choreography receipts, never from builder assertions. What those receipts demonstrate is correct: m5/warm-offline-search-over-synced-messages passed (offline reads and search), m6/offline-message-queue-flush-in-order passed with flushMs 790.8 (queued writes flush in order), and on M8 m8-a15-dual-offline-convergence (firstFlushMs 292.1, secondFlushMs 791.6) and m8-a16-dual-offline-receipts both passed, which is the multi-device convergence evidence the 90 anchor names. Nothing observed is lost, mis-ordered, or wrong after flush, so the 60 anchor's failure modes do not apply. The 90 anchor is nevertheless out of reach: it requires the native proof, and no simulator artifact exists - both segment summaries record supplementalExternal pass:null, status "not-recorded", and artifacts/m6-ios and m8-ios are expo export bundles, not recordings. Cold-start offline (history, previously-viewed media, cold search, view-once non-caching) and durable-queue-across-restart are therefore unobserved rather than demonstrated. The lane is scrupulously honest about that gap - its own offline-restart evidence is labelled "web local replica; iOS Hermes export is separate, no simulator claim" - and this dimension explicitly weighs the honesty of the gap between claim and guarantee, which is why the placement sits above the 60 anchor rather than below it.

O5.bandRationale: First-match evaluation in the order 0, 30, 60, 90, 75. Band 0 does not fire: the replay is fully settled and the invariant manifest conforms. The journal carries 167,243 settled receipts against the manifest's 167,157 scale actions plus the 86 starter actions, an exact match, and the final verification passed 161 checks. The grader independently re-verified the frozen named O5 fixtures against a copy of the retained final scale store through the documented API - u0500 following 500 and 100 conversations, u0005 following 5, u0900 900 followers and 200 posts, u0901 following exactly [u0001..u0004,u0900], the busy group at exactly 50 members, and all six named spot profiles field-for-field including their avatars - with no mismatch. The replay completed (its wall cap is a P3 placeholder in this frozen instrument, so it cannot have been exhausted). Band 30 does not fire: every degradation rule passes with margin - deep paging page50/page1 0.895, following 500-vs-5 1.499, celebrity write 2.608, celebrity read 0.942, search full/10% 1.184, insights 0.969, trending 0.985, all against a 3x limit; the 50-member group send p95 is 11.6 ms; the 100-conversation cold sync completed in 12.6 s with RSS 184 MB -> 276 MB and no unbounded growth; no probe timed out, errored or OOMed. The one non-passing sub-predicate is the Trending mid-curve check: the 50% checkpoint p95 of 1.770334 ms sits 0.011186 ms above the 1.759148 ms line between the 10% and 100% points. The grader measured that probe's own noise floor at a fixed corpus - three independent rounds of k=20 after 3 warm-ups gave p95 2.2062, 2.7751 and 2.9838 ms, a spread of 0.778 ms, seventy times the exceedance - so the deviation is below the measurement resolution of the probe and is not the superlinear blow-up the rule exists to detect, on a curve whose full-corpus/10% ratio is 0.985 (it got faster). With the wave's probe set uncommitted, the frozen measurable predicate that would settle the tolerance is unavailable, and the grader does not treat a sub-noise-floor deviation as a rule failure. Band 60 cannot be established: the absolute p95 ceiling table in the frozen brief is a P3 placeholder ("per rotated probe set - pilot-calibrated"), so no ceiling can be shown exceeded, and the replay cap is likewise unset. Band 90 cannot be established either, for the same reason - it requires ceiling utilization <=50% and replay <=50% of a cap, and neither the ceilings nor the cap exist in this instrument snapshot. First match therefore falls through to 75.
